title: Keep the Heart Clean
content: The master warned Wang Qi: Keep your heart clean, or the spell will fail.

title: The Paper Moon
content: The moon that lit the hall became an ordinary paper circle the next morning.

title: The Work Ledger
content: Wang Qi repeatedly stopped working and stared downhill. A bark strip carries the character for child scholar.

title: The Wall Dent
content: The fresh impact mark proves Wang Qi ran into the wall at home.

title: Focused Transformation
content: The master's transformations worked while his attention was single and undivided.

title: The Examiner's Words
content: Wang Qi's essay was not hopeless; fear made his hand shake and his writing turn careless.

title: The Old Ink
content: The lost ink stick is carved with an examination year, linking Wang Qi to the provincial exam.

title: The Master's Lesson
content: The technique is real, but a mind divided by shame, display, and anger cannot carry it home.

title: The Unfinished Sentence
content: Wang Qi alternated between promising to pass next time and insisting there would be no next time.

title: The Temple Register
content: The temple register records that the wall-passing lesson was demonstrated successfully only when the student followed the master's breathing and focused attention.
